item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - LeAnn Rimes' "How Great Thou Art" from 'Everbody's Sweetheart'
item.description: I am looking for the full two minutes and twenty-three second song from LeAnn Rimes' Everbody's Sweetheart. All files I have found are corrupted and cut at 1:44 but I am sure there has got to be a copy of the full song out there as the song was originally uploaded to a fan site called leannrimes.ru back in the day and I have trouble believing that there isn't someone who downloaded the song from that site and has it in full. The site has been defunct and I have checked Wayback Machine and the file was not ever saved despite much of the website being archived. If anyone has this, please share it because it would be sad for her cover of the song to be lost to time.
